title: The brainstem account of primordial feelings fits the lesion evidence

statements.text: The hypothesis that brainstem nuclei generate the primordial feelings of core self-awareness fits a patient with spared brainstem and preserved self-awareness, the long link between brainstem tegmentum damage and impaired consciousness, and core self-awareness in children born without a cortex.

sources.quote: entirely compatible with our findings (as R does not have brainstem damage)
children who are missing their cortex due to hydranencephaly
